## Services

### Junk Removal
**Q:** What is junk removal?
**A:** Junk removal is professional hauling of unwanted furniture, appliances, boxes, and clutter from your home or garage. Easy Garage Cleaning provides flat-rate junk removal in Fort Collins from photos — we lift, haul, donate usable items, and recycle the rest with no hourly billing.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/junk-removal-fort-collins-co.html

### Garage Cleanout
**Q:** What is a garage cleanout?
**A:** A garage cleanout is a full haul-out of unwanted garage contents — furniture, boxes, tools, and clutter — followed by donation drop-offs and a floor sweep so you can park inside again. We quote flat-rate from photos; labor, hauling, and dump fees are included.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-cleanouts-fort-collins-co.html

### Garage Cleaning
**Q:** What is garage cleaning?
**A:** Garage cleaning is a post-cleanout reset: sweeping floors, removing dust and cobwebs, and wiping accessible surfaces after junk is gone. It turns an empty garage into a truly clean, usable space — often booked with a garage cleanout in Fort Collins.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-cleaning-fort-collins-co.html

### Garage Turnaround
**Q:** What is a garage turnaround?
**A:** A garage turnaround is Easy Garage Cleaning's one-day garage transformation in Fort Collins: full cleanout, donation runs, keep-items re-homed, wall shelving, labeled zones, a parking layout, and a sweep — typically $1,200–$2,200 within the $400–$3,500 cleanout range. Call (970) 999-1818 for a locked flat-rate quote.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-turnaround-fort-collins-co.html

### Garage Organization
**Q:** What is garage organization?
**A:** Garage organization is structured zoning after a cleanout — shelving plans, labeled bins, and layout so items have a permanent home. Easy Garage Cleaning helps Northern Colorado homeowners keep garages clear long-term, not just empty for a week.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-organization-fort-collins-co.html

### Furniture Removal
**Q:** What is furniture removal?
**A:** Furniture removal is pickup and haul-away of couches, beds, dressers, tables, and other bulky pieces from your garage or home. We carry items out, donate what's usable to local charities, and dispose of the rest with a flat-rate photo quote.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/furniture-removal-fort-collins-co.html

### Appliance Removal
**Q:** What is appliance removal?
**A:** Appliance removal covers fridges, washers, dryers, water heaters, and other large appliances hauled from your property. Working units may go to Habitat ReStore Fort Collins; we handle heavy lifting and proper disposal with flat-rate pricing.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/appliance-removal-fort-collins-co.html

### Mattress Removal
**Q:** What is mattress removal?
**A:** Mattress removal is haul-away of mattresses and box springs from garages, bedrooms, or curbside. We handle the weight and disposal requirements so you do not need a truck rental — quoted flat from photos before we arrive.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/mattress-removal-fort-collins-co.html

### Storage Unit Cleanout
**Q:** What is a storage unit cleanout?
**A:** A storage unit cleanout empties a paid storage unit in one trip — boxes, furniture, and forgotten items hauled, donated, or disposed. Ideal when monthly fees exceed the value of what's inside; we quote flat from photos of the unit.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/storage-unit-cleanout-fort-collins-co.html

### Yard Debris Removal
**Q:** What is yard debris removal?
**A:** Yard debris removal hauls branches, lawn equipment, outdoor furniture, and garage-stored yard clutter from your property. We load, haul, and recycle or dispose — common after storms or when clearing space for parking.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/yard-debris-removal-fort-collins-co.html

## Pricing

| Tier | Range | Scope |
|------|-------|-------|
| Basic clear-out | $400–$650 | Single-car or lighter two-car garage, hauled & swept |
| Full cleanout | $650–$1,200 | Packed two-car garage with donation runs handled |
| Garage turnaround | $1,200–$2,200 | Cleanout + shelving + zones + parking layout, in one day |
| Whole-property reset | $2,200–$3,500 | Garage, basement, shed & side yard + deep garage clean |
| Single item | Call for price | One couch, mattress, appliance — quoted on the spot |

## Automation

Leads are managed via **Zapier + Quo + Firebase Firestore** (`leads` collection, phone doc IDs). Website forms submit to Web3forms with Zapier-ready fields (`phone`, `name`, `items`, `source=Website`, `status=new`). Customers opt out by replying **STOP** (TCPA — no further automated SMS). Full spec: `/docs/zapier-automation.md`.

## FAQs

1. **How much does a garage cleanout cost in Fort Collins?** Garage cleanouts run $400–$3,500 flat-rate: roughly $400–$650 for a basic single-car clear-out, $650–$1,200 for a packed two-car cleanout with donation runs, $1,200–$2,200 for a full turnaround with shelving and organization, and $2,200–$3,500 for a whole-property reset with a deep garage clean. Call (970) 999-1818 for your exact locked quote before we start.

2. **How do I get a quote with photos?** Text (970) 999-1818 or use https://easygaragecleaning.com/book.html — choose service, city, upload photos, contact info. Response within 5 minutes Mon–Sat 7am–7pm.

3. **Do you offer same-day service?** Yes when the schedule allows — often same-day or next-day in Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, and Wellington.

4. **Are you licensed and insured?** Yes — Easy Garage Cleaning LLC is a Colorado-registered LLC with general liability and commercial auto insurance on every job.

5. **Do you donate usable items?** Yes — Habitat ReStore Fort Collins, ARC, and Goodwill when items qualify; tax receipt in the customer's name.

6. **Flat rate or hourly?** Flat rate only. The price quoted from photos is what you pay — no hourly clock or end-of-job surprises.

7. **What is a garage cleanout?** Full haul-out of garage contents you mark for removal, donation drop-offs, and a floor sweep so you can park inside again.

8. **What can't you take?** Liquid paint, gasoline, solvents, asbestos, medical/biohazard waste, live ammunition, and large motor-oil quantities.

9. **Do I need to sort before you arrive?** No — mark what stays; we handle lifting, loading, donations, and disposal.

10. **What's included in the price?** Labor, hauling, disposal fees, donation runs (with receipts), and a floor sweep — all in the flat rate, locked before we start. No hidden line items.

11. **Easy Garage Cleaning vs GOT-JUNK?** Local owner on job, photo flat quotes, garage specialist vs national franchise volume/hourly pricing. See comparison blog.

12. **What areas do you serve?** Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, Timnath, Wellington, Severance, LaPorte — Larimer County daily.

13. **Do you haul from inside the garage?** Yes — garage, basement, and ground-floor areas we can access safely.

14. **When do I pay?** After you approve the flat-rate quote — not before the job.

15. **Can I book online?** Yes — https://easygaragecleaning.com/book.html with service picker, city, photos, and timing.

16. **How long does a garage cleanout take?** Most single-car garages 2–4 hours; full two-car 3–5 hours depending on volume.

17. **Do you sweep after cleanout?** Yes — a basic floor sweep is included so the space is usable immediately.

18. **Single-item pickup price?** Small one-item hauls are quoted on the spot — call (970) 999-1818. Our focus is full garage cleanouts and turnarounds ($400–$3,500).

19. **Storage unit cleanout?** Yes — empty a paid unit in one trip; quoted flat from photos of unit contents.

20. **Estate or whole-property cleanouts?** Yes — a whole-property reset (garage, basement, shed, side yard) in one day runs about $2,200–$3,500; custom flat quote from a photo or video walkthrough first.

21. **What happens to items after pickup?** Donations first, then Larimer County Landfill or recycling — never illegal dumping.

22. **Who owns Easy Garage Cleaning?** Zac Bezenek — CSU student, owner on jobs. https://easygaragecleaning.com/about.html

Full FAQ page: https://easygaragecleaning.com/faq.html
